newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Syndicate group forms for Eurofima HK$400 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: Syndicate group forms for Eurofima HK$400 mln bond.

text.p: A syndicate group has been formed for Eurofima's HK$400 million six-year bond issue, lead manager Societe General Asia said.
The bond pays a 7.72 percent coupon semi-annually and was priced at 100.25 to yield 108 basis points over comparable U.S. Treasuries or 35 basis points over comparable Hong Kong Exchange Fund Notes.
Lead manager Societe Generale Asia committed to HK$210 million.
Co-lead managers, with HK$35 million each, are Standard Chartered Investment Banking and Commmonwealth Bank of Australia.
Co-managers, with HK$20 million each, are Chase Manhattan Asia, HSBC Markets, IBJ Asia, Jardine Fleming, Oakreed Financial Services and Tokyo-Mitsubishi.
